(I)--married शान्ति, a daughter of Kardama. It was he who spread यज्ञ in the world.
1: भा. III. २४. २४.
His son was दध्यञ्च who had a horse's head.
2: Ib.
(II)--a ब्राह्मन् priest invited by युधिष्- ठिर to officiate in his राजसूय sacrifice. भा. X. ७४. 9.

--one of the four Vedas useful for kings.
1: भा., X. ५३. १२; वा. 9. ५१; ६०. १५, २०.
Rearranged by Sumantu (s.v.) under the guidance of व्यास; in five parts.
2: भा.

. ३७.

4: Br. IV. २०. १०४.

1: भा.
